name: LiveKit SIP
what_it_is: A SIP-to-WebRTC bridge service that connects telephony networks to LiveKit rooms via SIP trunking. It runs as a standalone service alongside livekit-server, enabling inbound and outbound SIP calls to participate as LiveKit room participants.
measurement: Health check HTTP endpoint (health_port config field)
Log levels: debug, info, warn, error
configuration: YAML config file via SIP_CONFIG_FILE env var (path) or SIP_CONFIG_BODY env var (inline body)
Required fields: api_key, api_secret, ws_url, redis.address
Optional: health_port, prometheus_port, log_level, sip_port (default 5060), rtp_port (default 10000-20000), use_external_ip
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection mechanisms documented
Redis dependency: removing or stopping Redis breaks session state and SIP-LiveKit communication
modes: Inbound mode: accepts SIP INVITEs, dispatches callers into LiveKit rooms via SIP Dispatch Rules
Outbound mode: sends SIP INVITEs to external SIP endpoints
Native mode: built with Go + libopus, runs directly on host
Docker mode: requires --network host due to large RTP port range (10000-20000)
constraints: Must expose a public IP address for remote SIP peers to connect; use_external_ip must be set in containerized/cloud deployments
Requires host networking (--network host) in Docker due to large UDP port range (5060 + 10000-20000) that Docker cannot efficiently NAT
Redis must be the same instance shared with livekit-server — not a separate Redis
SIP Trunk and SIP Dispatch Rule must be provisioned via livekit-server API or livekit-cli before calls can be routed
Built in Go; libopus (plus libopusfile, libsoxr) must be installed natively for non-Docker builds
docker_services: livekit (image: livekit/livekit-server, network_mode: host, --dev flag, depends on redis)
sip (image: livekit/sip, network_mode: host, config via SIP_CONFIG_BODY env var)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in repo root (file is docker-compose.yaml)
No horizontal scaling / multi-instance coordination documented
No video support — audio-only SIP bridge
No WebRTC-to-SIP transcoding quality controls (bitrate, codec negotiation) exposed in config
